    1. apply(VirtualView)

Interface Event

All Superinterfaces:
Message, Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
GameEvent, HeartbeatEvent, LobbyEvent
All Known Implementing Classes:
AutoPlayerInvokedEvent, AutoPlayerTimerStartedEvent, BoardUpdatedEvent, CardTakenEvent, CurrentPlayerChangedEvent, EraChangedEvent, ErrorEvent, EventResolvedEvent, ExtraTurnEndedEvent, ExtraTurnStartedEvent, GameAbortedEvent, GameEndedEvent, GameRecoveryFailedEvent, GameSetupCompletedEvent, GameStartedEvent, GlobalTimerCancelledEvent, GlobalTimerStartedEvent, LobbyDissolvedEvent, PhaseChangedEvent, PingEvent, PlayerDisconnectedEvent, PlayerLimitsInitializedEvent, PlayerLimitsUpdatedEvent, PlayerReconnectedEvent, PlayerResourceChangedEvent, PongEvent, TotemPlacedEvent, TotemReturnedEvent, TurnOrderEstablishedEvent, UpdatedLobbiesEvent, UpdatedLobbyEvent, UsernameResultEvent
public sealed interface Event extends Message permits LobbyEvent, GameEvent, ErrorEvent, HeartbeatEvent
Sealed interface for all server-to-client events. Each concrete record carries its payload as record components and implements apply(VirtualView) to dispatch itself to the correct VirtualView method, eliminating switch logic in client-side transport handlers.

Subtypes are grouped into:

  • LobbyEvent — pre-game lobby notifications
  • GameEvent — in-game state notifications
  • ErrorEvent — error responses
  • HeartbeatEvent — liveness probes (PingEvent, PongEvent), handled at the transport layer

    • apply

      void apply(VirtualView view)
      Applies this event to the given view, calling the appropriate VirtualView notification method.

      Heartbeat subtypes (PingEvent, PongEvent) are intercepted before this method is called; invoking apply on them throws UnsupportedOperationException.

      Parameters:
      view - the client-side view to notify
